limitations: Compiled client scenarios use Node VM synthetic host/provider fixtures; no current native Loon/Surge or online API acceptance.
Surge/Loon device memory, battery, latency and long-term VPN stability were not measured.
The normalized Apple fallback retains an additional bounded body for correctness; no resource improvement claimed.
Draft resource URLs refer to an unpublished local ref and cannot be treated as live import URLs.
Current production fixes and build results target the Fork/main-based schema 1.1.2, not upstream dev/PR110 schema 2.0.5.
